data.name: Nufaysah
data.gender_notes: Nufaysah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nufus’, meaning ‘soul’, and ‘hawwa’, meaning ‘breeze’ or ‘gentle wind’. In Islamic tradition, the soul is considered a gentle breeze from Allah, breathed into the human being at the moment of birth. The name Nufaysah carries the meaning “Gentle breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nufaysah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle presence of Allah in one's life.
data.etymology: Nufaysah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nufaysah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
